title: Microsegment Buyer-Persona Matrix for Inference Procurement (Prototype)
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Deliver a reproducible microsegment buyer-persona matrix and interactive visualization to inform procurement playbooks for inference products. Output will include: (1) a validated buyer persona matrix (CSV/Sheets) mapping procurement triggers, latency tolerance, pricing sensitivity, approval cycles, and security constraints; (2) three prioritized procurement playbooks (startup/scale, platform-team, regulated-enterprise) with recommended product-packaging/pricing levers; (3) an interactive prototype visualization for the GTM and sales teams.
acceptance_criteria: Buyer persona matrix (Sheets/CSV) completed with >= 12 validated data points across target segments
Three procurement playbooks drafted and reviewed by Sales and Solutions Engineering
Interactive visualization prototype deployed to the internal dashboard link and approved by PM lead
Findings summarized in a 2-page executive brief and annotated recommendations for pricing and feature packaging
decisions: Prioritize three microsegments: AI-native startups, central platform teams (SaaS), and regulated-enterprise (fin/health)
Use mixed-methods research: 8 vendor/customer interviews + 30 synthetic RFx scans of public procurement docs + telemetry-backed usage buckets
Prototype visualization will be a lightweight Vega-lite embed in the internal dashboard rather than a full React app for speed
